title: LP-importer-mapping-recon-1.2.0 — UI: registry-driven mapping options & autosuggest
author: twgallo13

coderabbit_summary.summary_by_coderabbit:
* **New Features** - Registry-driven attribute mapping system for CSV imports with auto-suggestions based on column headers - Attribute ID auto-generation and uniqueness validation during creation - Product domain validation against attribute registry with real-time validation feedback - Improved mapping UI with field metadata display and reference-only indicators
* **Improvements** - Enhanced attribute creation flow with field-level validation and error messages - Refined test performance with optimized timeouts and reduced retries

NEW - Presentational component for rich field option display
Registry-driven options, autosuggest with scoring algorithm
